findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: xrplme_intent_search · Private data: xrplme_get_country_schema, xrplme_deep_records, xrplme_aggregate, xrplme_intent_post, xrplme_intent_pro · Public sink: xrplme_submit_survey, xrplme_aggregate, xrplme_intent_post, xrplme_intent_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: xrplme_intent_search · Private data: xrplme_get_country_schema, xrplme_deep_records, xrplme_aggregate, xrplme_intent_post, xrplme_intent_pro · Public sink: xrplme_submit_survey, xrplme_aggregate, xrplme_intent_post, xrplme_intent_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
